sections.html:
• Scientific name: Neblinichthys pilosus Ferraris, Isbrücker & Nijssen, 1986
  • Common name: Punk Pleco
  • Size: 89 mm (3.5 in) SL
  • IUCN Red List: Least Concern (last assessed 2019)
  • Etymology: Neblin- is based on the Neblina camp, where the type specimen was caught. -ichthys: fish. Literally "fish from Neblina". The specific epithet refers to its hairy (pilosus = hairy) appearance.
  • Type locality: Río Mawarinuma tributary, at Neblina base camp, on the right bank in a riffle, 0°55'N, 66°10'W, Venezuela, elevation 120 m.
South America: Upper Negro, Casiquiare, and Baria River basins in Venezuela.
Revue française d'Aquariologie Herpétologie v. 13 (no. 3), pp 70, Figs. 1, 4-5.
